name: ID-JAG Standalone LAB
description: Token exchange with ID-JAG, using a mock authorization server and a sample MCP server.
notes: Host-run: npm run build && npm start (port 4720). Or: docker compose -f deploy/docker-compose.yml up --build -d (publishes 127.0.0.1 only: 4720 playground, 4721 resource-as, 4722 mcp-sample).
